Name: AI Security Reader
Description: Assess the AI and storage estate without the ability to change it or to obtain a credential. Built from observed activity-log operations rather than from a built-in role. Deliberately omits Microsoft.CognitiveServices/accounts/listKeys/action: a principal that can list keys is an operator, because the key is a bearer credential to the model endpoint. Controls: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 AC-3, AC-5, AC-6; NERC CIP-004-7 R4; NERC CIP-007-6 R5; ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.5.15. NOTE: Microsoft.Security/regulatoryComplianceStandards/read was removed after Azure rejected it with InvalidActionOrNotAction - the action does not exist. Azure validates every action string against the provider, so a role definition cannot contain an invented permission.
